display.purpose: Section headings: short statements ending in a full stop, revealed line by line.

headline.purpose: Full-screen menu items and the closing gallery link; phone number in the same tight setting at 400.

title.purpose: Subheadings, form confirmation, and (scaled up) the extension house rule.

label.purpose: Section index labels, footer heads, intro tagline, scroll hint; uppercase, mute.

control.purpose: Pill text, Menu toggle, form field labels.

shadows.name: point-pulse
shadows.purpose: Expanding ring on the confirmation point after a sent form; off under reduced motion.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Doubles the input underline on keyboard focus.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default CSS easing for all state transitions (GSAP expo.out equivalent).

motion.name: circle-reveal
motion.value: clip-path circle(0% -> 75% at 50% 50%), 1.9s power3.inOut, image scale 1.16 parallax

motion.name: line-reveal
motion.purpose: Display headings rise from a mask, line by line.

motion.name: menu-open
motion.value: clip-path circle(0% -> 150%) from the toggle, 1s ease-out
motion.purpose: Full-screen menu opens as a circle.

motion.name: photo-colour
motion.value: filter grayscale(1) sepia(.16) contrast(1.04) brightness(.94) -> none, 1.2s
motion.purpose: Warm monochrome to colour on fine-pointer hover.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Slow, soft scroll; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No pin, zoom, clip or parallax when prefers-reduced-motion is set.

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: Primary action (Afspraak, Verstuur): paper fill that drains to outline on hover.
components.css: :host{--ink:#141414;--ink-2:#1e1e1e;--paper:#fafafa;--mute:#8a8a8a;--line:rgba(250,250,250,.12);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);font-family:'Outfit Variable','Outfit',system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:2.6rem;padding:0 1.35rem;border:1px solid var(--paper);border-radius:999px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.06em;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:background-color .5s var(--ease-out),color .5s var(--ease-out),transform .2s;} .ds-pill:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--paper);} .ds-pill:active{transform:scale(.98);} .ds-pill:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--paper);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: Multi-select treatment pill in the booking form.
components.css: :host{--ink:#141414;--ink-2:#1e1e1e;--paper:#fafafa;--mute:#8a8a8a;--line:rgba(250,250,250,.12);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);font-family:'Outfit Variable','Outfit',system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-chip{position:relative;display:inline-block;color:var(--paper);} .ds-chip input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;} .ds-chip span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:2.5rem;padding:0 1.15rem;border:1px solid rgba(250,250,250,.32);border-radius:999px;font-size:.88rem;letter-spacing:.02em;transition:background-color .4s var(--ease-out),color .4s var(--ease-out),border-color .4s;} .ds-chip:hover span{border-color:var(--paper);} .ds-chip input:checked+span{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--paper);} .ds-chip input:focus-visible+span{outline:1px solid var(--paper);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Underline Field

components.css: :host{--ink:#141414;--ink-2:#1e1e1e;--paper:#fafafa;--mute:#8a8a8a;--line:rgba(250,250,250,.12);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);font-family:'Outfit Variable','Outfit',system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-field{display:grid;gap:.5rem;color:var(--paper);} .ds-field label{font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.06em;} .ds-field input{width:100%;font:inherit;font-weight:300;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--paper);background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(250,250,250,.32);border-radius:0;padding:.55rem 0 .7rem;transition:border-color .4s var(--ease-out);} .ds-field input::placeholder{color:#9a9a9a;} .ds-field input:focus{outline:none;border-bottom-color:var(--paper);} .ds-field input:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 1px 0 0 var(--paper);} .ds-field__error{margin:0;font-size:.82rem;color:#f0b4ac;}

components.name: Navigation

components.css: :host{--ink:#141414;--ink-2:#1e1e1e;--paper:#fafafa;--mute:#8a8a8a;--line:rgba(250,250,250,.12);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);font-family:'Outfit Variable','Outfit',system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-nav{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:1.4rem;height:72px;padding:0 32px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);} .ds-nav__pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:2.6rem;padding:0 1.35rem;border:1px solid var(--paper);border-radius:999px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .5s var(--ease-out),color .5s var(--ease-out);} .ds-nav__pill:hover{background:transparent;color:var(--paper);} .ds-nav__menu{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;height:2.6rem;font:inherit;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.06em;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;} .ds-nav__dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);transition:transform .6s var(--ease-out);} .ds-nav__menu:hover .ds-nav__dot,.ds-nav__menu:focus-visible .ds-nav__dot{transform:scale(1.8);} .ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-nav__menu:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--paper);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Photo Frame
components.description: Square frame on Raised Black; warm monochrome image, colour on hover. Empty frames hold only the point.
components.css: :host{--ink:#141414;--ink-2:#1e1e1e;--paper:#fafafa;--mute:#8a8a8a;--line:rgba(250,250,250,.12);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);font-family:'Outfit Variable','Outfit',system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-photo{margin:0;width:240px;aspect-ratio:4/5;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink-2);border-radius:0;} .ds-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;filter:grayscale(1) sepia(.16) contrast(1.04) brightness(.94);transition:filter 1.2s var(--ease-out);} .ds-photo:hover img{filter:none;} .ds-dot{display:block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);}

components.css: :host{--ink:#141414;--ink-2:#1e1e1e;--paper:#fafafa;--mute:#8a8a8a;--line:rgba(250,250,250,.12);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);font-family:'Outfit Variable','Outfit',system-ui,sans-serif;} .ds-done{display:grid;gap:1.8rem;justify-items:start;padding:2rem;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);} .ds-done p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(1.45rem,1.1rem + 1.4vw,2.35rem);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.15;} .ds-point{display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);animation:ds-pulse 2.6s var(--ease-out) infinite;} @keyframes ds-pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(250,250,250,.35);}70%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 22px rgba(250,250,250,0);}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-point{animation:none;}}

narrative.northStar: The Door in the Full Stop
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Door in the Full Stop"**

Salon Dola is a private atelier you enter through a punctuation mark. The point after "DOLA." is the one figure the whole system is built from: it is the cursor, the shape that opens every photograph, the window the intro zooms through, the menu's toggle and the quiet pulse that confirms a sent form. Everything else is type on broken black, set in a single family and scaled hard, with thin light lines as the only structure.

The register is a fashion house, not a high-street salon. Density is low and the pace is slow: generous section spacing, long expo-out eases, photographs held back in warm monochrome until the pointer asks for colour. Warmth comes from the photography and the restraint, never from an accent colour or ornament. The logo's own two voices, a thin, widely tracked "SALON" and a tight, heavy "DOLA.", are the two voices of every page: tracked labels and tightly set display headings that end on a full stop.

The brief rejects the salon template of hero photo, service cards and price list, and rejects decorative icons; the build carries no icon set.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black and white, warm-toned grayscale photography, no accent colour.
Outfit only; scale and tracking do all the hierarchy work.
Circles are the only curved shape; every plane, photo and frame is square.
Headings are short statements that close with a full stop.
Motion is slow and soft; reduced motion falls back to fades only.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no brand accent. Emphasis is made with scale, weight, white fill or a line, never with hue. The error rose is the only colour and appears only when something has gone wrong.

rules.name: The Warm Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Photographs are shown grayscale with a slight warm cast (grayscale 1, sepia .16, contrast 1.04, brightness .94) and return to full colour on pointer hover over 1.2s. Touch devices keep the monochrome.

rules.name: The Full Stop Rule
rules.body: Display headings and menu items are short declaratives that end on a period. The point is part of the word, not a decoration.

rules.name: The SALON Tracking Rule
rules.body: Wide 0.5em tracking belongs only to small uppercase labels at weight 300. Never track display type open; never set labels heavy.

rules.name: The Flat Atelier Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Shadow appears only as the point's pulse ring and as a focus underline, never to lift a surface.

rules.name: The Point or Square Rule
rules.body: If it is clickable as a pill or behaves like the point, it is round; everything else has zero radius. There are no intermediate radii.

rules.name: The Circle Reveal Rule
rules.body: Photographs enter by a clip-path circle opening from the centre (0% to 75%, 1.9s power3.inOut) with a light parallax scale from 1.16. Under reduced motion they fade.

dos: Do build every emphasis from ink, paper, scale and a 1px line; keep the error rose for errors only.
Do end display headings and menu items with a full stop.
Do keep wide 0.5em tracking for small weight-300 uppercase labels, and compensate trailing tracking when centred.
Do reveal photographs with a circle opening and show them in warm monochrome, colour on hover only on fine pointers.
Do use slow expo-out easing (cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)) and long durations (1.2s to 2s); fall back to fades under reduced motion.
Do use the point as the placeholder for missing photography rather than generic grey boxes or stock imagery.
donts: Don't introduce an accent colour or a second typeface.
Don't use any radius other than 0, fully round pill or circle.
Don't lift surfaces with drop shadows or build card grids; the salon template of hero photo, service cards and price list is rejected.
Don't use decorative icons, emoji or exclamation marks; the point is the only mark.
Don't show the custom cursor on touch devices.
